title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Thank you for choosing me, Darling. Now, what kind of secret are you going to share with me under this velvet of the night?

title: Talk 1
original: Fiend of the Night? Ah, I can't hide anything from you. But past glory is nothing to me. After all, I have an even brighter future waiting.

title: Talk 2
original: I may work in a different place now, but my job is still the same—to put a smile on everyone's face.

title: Talk 3
original: I bet Ms. Orchid must have been born with a negative number on her happiness scale. Why else would she always look so stern whenever I'm there to light her up? If you know anything about her, please tell me.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: People say my swordsmanship is top notch. All due credit, I have to say. Practicing swordsmanship helps me maintain my figure and cultivate my elegance. It'd be a crime for me to slack off on the pratice. After all, you either keep the momentum and hold the lead or end up getting overwhelmed. Please keep that in mind.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: People used to say that I sold feelings as commodities, that I treated 'happiness' as a product. Fools, all of them. How can I expect my customers to open their hearts to me if I don't open mine to them first?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I believe happiness can be contagious. It's a tangible atmosphere that truly exists. I feel the joy when others treat me with sincerity, and I will make sure my happiness reaches right into their hearts.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My colleagues in team A6... they may be a bit weird, but they're truly kind souls. They're a gift from destiny, a gift that continues to remind me to cherish those important to me.

title: Idle
original: Now that I have some free time, I should read.

title: Onboard
original: Show me your brightest smile, my esteemed customer! Happiness is at arm's reach when you're by my side. Midnight, at your service.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: It's important to never stop learning!

title: Promotion 1
original: Whoa, so my hard work really paid off! Let's set up a champagne tower to celebrate. My treat.

title: Added to Squad
original: With me on your side, success is guaranteed!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Follow this handsome me!

title: Depart
original: Show me your spirit, everyone!

title: Begin Operation
original: Behold, here comes my flamboyant moves!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hmm?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What's up?

title: Deployment 1
original: I've arrived.

title: Deployment 2
original: OK.

title: In Battle 1
original: O sword, pierce the moonlight that veils the night!

title: In Battle 2
original: Bathe in fresh blood!

title: 4-star Result
original: Impressive, Dr. {@nickname}, truly impressive. Your blazing brilliance almost stole my show today.

title: 3-star Result
original: There's only one thing that's impossible for me: being imperfect.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Not too shabby. Such a heart-warming result calls for a little celebration.

title: Operation Failure
original: No need to look back. We'll greet each other with a smile next time.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: A wonderful place. Let's have a drinking party tonight.

title: Tap
original: There now, would you please leave my collar as it is?

title: Trust Tap
original: Thanks for taking care of me.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Sometimes, it doesn't take flowery tricks to capture a customer's heart. See the fireworks here? The sight of them going off, even just for an instant, will be enough to focus all the customers' attention solely on me, their souls scorched by my gaze... Orchid? Why are you dragging me away?

title: Greeting
original: Good evening, Dr. {@nickname}.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday. You should set your work aside for today. We can chat until dawn, and I'll stick by your side if you want to watch the sun rise. But {@nickname}, I trust that you know what to say if Orchid asks why I didn't work overtime tonight.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: What you see today is the fruit of all your hard work, {@nickname}. Nothing makes me happier than accompanying someone in admiring their own marvelous achievements. I do hope you'll still choose me to stay by your side this time next year.
